My other apps

The ones people download most, and a few I'm proudest of.

OpenTasker · Android · ⭐145 · 11,000+ downloads
Phone automation in the spirit of Tasker, fully open source. Readable rules, 78 built-in actions, and all of it runs on your phone.

NVMe Driver Patcher · Windows 11 · ⭐80 · 8,000+ downloads
Switches Windows 11 to the native NVMe driver from Server 2025. It checks your system before it changes anything and keeps a clean way back.

Hushfeed · Android, Morphe patches · ⭐206 · 60,000+ downloads
A patch bundle for TikTok. Fewer accidental taps, less noise, and more say over your feed and your downloads.

Hushfacebook · Android, Morphe patches · ⭐268 · 47,000+ downloads
A patch bundle for Facebook. Keeps your friends in the feed and clears out the ads, Reels and Stories clutter.

AppManagerNG · Android · ⭐139 · 7,500+ downloads
See every app on your phone and what it can reach. Debloat, freeze and back up from one place, with or without root.

Video Subtitle Remover · Windows · ⭐93 · 5,000+ downloads
Takes burned-in subtitles and on-screen text out of video, right on your PC. You review each text track before anything is removed.

DeepPurge · Windows · ⭐22
An uninstaller that shows you what it's about to remove before it does, and keeps a recovery trail when it's done.

Openshop · Web · ⭐24
A full image editor in a browser tab, with layers and PSD support. No signup, and your files stay on your machine.

eddyizm.com

Creating a new personal site, blog using django and python.

Set up

This guide assumes you already have python 3 and git installed.

Clone repository

git clone https://github.com/eddyizm/eddyizm.git

Create a virtual environment

python -m venv </path/to/new/virtual/environment>

Changed directory and activate virtual environment

   cd </path/to/new/virtual/environment>  
   Scripts\activate
   # in bash use this instead
   source Scripts/activate
   cd </pathToGitProject>

Install Django and verify version installed

pip install django   
django-admin --version

podman

build and run podman build -t eddyizm_blog -f ContainerFile --ignorefile .dockerignore

podman run --name=blog -d -p 8000:8000 -v ~/src/eddyizm/data:/data:rw -v ~/src/eddyizm/static:/static:rw -v ~/src/eddyizm/media:/media:rw localhost/eddyizm_blog
